list_child.name: listPlacements
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of course placements currently on file at the language school. This includes every student track regardless of its current phase.

get_child.name: getPlacement
get_child.desc: Look up a single course placement using its unique identifier. Returns the full placement record for that student's track.

list_parent.name: listStudents
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the full list of students who have ever enrolled at the language school. Every registered learner appears in this listing.

get_parent.name: getStudent
get_parent.desc: Look up a single student record using their unique identifier. Returns all details the school keeps on file for that student.

delete_child.name: deletePlacement
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a course placement record from the school's system, an action that cannot be undone once completed. Use this only when a placement was created in error or is no longer needed.

set_enum.name: setPlacementPhase
set_enum.desc: Update the phase of a course placement to reflect whether the student is placed, transferred, or has withdrawn. This keeps the roster accurate for scheduling and reporting purposes.

set_bool.name: flagScholarshipFunded
set_bool.desc: Mark a course placement as scholarship-funded so that finance can track which students receive tuition assistance. This flag affects downstream billing reports.

set_ref.name: transferStudent
set_ref.desc: Move a course placement from one student's record to another, which is useful when a placement was logged under the wrong learner. The change is reflected immediately across all reporting views.

send.name: messageStudent
send.desc: Send a message to a student regarding their course placement or general standing at the school. This is the primary channel for placement-related communication.
child_verbs: reach out to the student on {obj}
